newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,549 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,549 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1549 contracts, compared with 1015 contracts traded overnight Wednesday.
There were 34 wheat, 636 corn, 757 soybean, 104 soymeal, seven soyoil, three oat, two corn call and six soybean put contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent higher, corn 1/2 to 3/4 lower, soybeans 1/2 to 1-1/2 lower, soymeal $0.80 to $0.90 per ton lower and soyoil 0.02 cent per lb higher.
